description: React + Vite installable PWA frontend with a reachable, working UI path for every actor and use case (student, reviewer/annotator, admin, issuer). Plain professional styling (no gradients/glassmorphism), auth context with JWT, axios API client, Vite dev proxy to the backend. Corresponds to tasks.md T9. Depends on FEAT-003 (needs API + seeded demo users).
steps: Scaffold apps/web with Vite (react-ts template), React Router, and vite-plugin-pwa (manifest + service worker) so the app is installable. Configure Vite dev server proxy so /api -> http://127.0.0.1:8000.
Auth context storing JWT in localStorage; axios (or fetch) client attaching Authorization: Bearer; login and register pages posting to /api/auth. Role-aware navigation.

Student views: /submit (file upload AND paste text) calling /api/ingest/submit; /result/:id showing relationship label + confidence + evidence trail (extracted fields, candidate, rationale) + a 'Verify integrity' button calling /api/provenance/verify/{id} and showing tamper status; /notices browsing official notices; /alerts with a subscribe toggle.

Reviewer views: /reviewer/queue (unresolved cases), /reviewer/case/:id (confirm/correct relationship), /reviewer/benchmark (two-annotator annotation UI + Cohen's kappa report from /api/reviewer/benchmark/kappa).
Admin view: /admin/sources listing institutions with add form and a 'Trigger fetch' button calling /api/ingest/fetch. Issuer view: /issuer/publish form calling /api/issuer/publish (labeled stub).
Plain professional CSS (system font, simple tables/forms/cards, no gradient/glassmorphism). Ensure every route renders real data from the API - no placeholder-only screens.
Ensure npm run build succeeds and emits the PWA manifest + service worker.
acceptance_criteria: cd apps/web && npm install && npm run build succeeds
Build emits a PWA manifest and a service worker (installable PWA)
There is a working route for each actor: student (submit/result/notices/alerts), reviewer (queue/case/benchmark), admin (sources+fetch), issuer (publish)
Each view calls its corresponding backend API (no placeholder-only screens)
verification: cd apps/web && npm install && npm run build
findings: Built the React+Vite+TypeScript installable PWA under apps/web. Stack: Vite 5 + React 18 + react-router-dom 6 + axios + vite-plugin-pwa 0.20 (generateSW). `npm install && npm run build` succeeds and emits dist/manifest.webmanifest + dist/sw.js + dist/workbox-*.js + dist/registerSW.js (installable PWA, R7.2). Vite dev proxy forwards /api -> http://127.0.0.1:8000 (vite.config.ts). Auth: AuthContext stores the JWT in localStorage; axios request interceptor attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; login uses the OAuth2 password flow (x-www-form-urlencoded username/password) then GET /auth/me; register posts JSON then auto-logs-in. Role-aware NavBar + ProtectedRoute (auth + role gating). Views, all data-backed (no placeholders): student /login /register /submit (multipart FormData text and/or file to /ingest/submit; friendly 422 handling for OCR-less image uploads) /result/:id (label+confidence+rationale badge, extracted fields evidence table, closest candidate, Verify integrity + Simulate tamper buttons calling /provenance/verify/{id}) /notices (list + detail from /notices) /alerts (per-issuer subscribe toggle persisted in localStorage, feed pulled from /notices); reviewer /reviewer/queue (/reviewer/queue) /reviewer/case/:id (confirm/correct via POST /reviewer/cases/{id}/resolve) /reviewer/benchmark (two-annotator annotate via /reviewer/benchmark/annotate + Cohen's kappa from /reviewer/benchmark/kappa); admin /admin/sources (list + add via /ingest/sources, Trigger fetch via /ingest/fetch); issuer /issuer/publish (labeled Tier-2 stub -> /issuer/publish). Plain professional CSS in src/styles.css (system font, flat colors, simple tables/forms/cards); NO gradients/glassmorphism (GC-8). PNG icons generated by scripts/gen-icons.mjs (zlib-only, no image dep) into public/icons. NOTE: the result label/confidence/rationale are only returned by POST /ingest/submit (no GET re-derives them), so the outcome is cached in sessionStorage (src/api/resultCache.ts) and shown on /result/:id; a plain reload without the cache still shows fields+candidate+integrity and a hint to re-submit. Verified the full API contract in-process against the seeded backend (TestClient): login/me, submit (-> superseded 0.86), notice detail, candidates, verify, notices(120), reviewer queue/pairs(14)/kappa(0.6627), admin sources(3)/fetch, issuer publish(201) all succeed. No git repo is initialized yet (orchestrator publishes later), so no commit was made; node_modules, dist, dev-dist, and *.db are already gitignored.
